probe.title: Love and Money | Design Consultancy, Melbourne
probe.text_sample: Love and Money | Design Consultancy, Melbourne A design consultancy. Melbourne, London, Los Angeles and Vancouver. Love and Money builds products, brands and businesses Love and money is not what you think it is Love And Money builds products, brands and businesses around a singular creative vision(ary). OUR PLAYBOOK 01 Find our humans Everything we do is designed around the lived experiences of real people. E.g. Research, Market Sizing and Brand Strategy 02 THINK BIG Knowing the experience we want to create, we come up with a big memetic idea that orients everything we do and makes every subsequent decision for the business obvious. E.g. Creative Direction, Tone of Voice and Messaging 03 Build a Product We build the object, tool, or interface that delivers on the experience we want to give our people. More often than not this is a creative product like a camera, keyboard or compact. E.g. Prototyping, Product Design, Manufacturing and Logistics 04 BUILD A WORLD We build a world around that product and in doing so give our people a compelling and flattering story about themselves they can share with their friends, and their mums. E.G. Go to Market Campaigns, Website Design and Conte
